chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub narrated from a number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Husayn ibn 'Uthman, from Is-haq ibn 'Ammar, from Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"When the absent husband wishes to divorce his wife, he should leave her for a month."
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling for a husband who is absent when he wants to divorce his wife?
ai.summary: In Shia jurisprudence, this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the procedure for a husband absent from his wife, establishing a one-month period to manage the *iddah* (waiting period) and ensure the divorce is properly executed in his absence. This ruling highlights the practical legal mechanisms developed by the Imams to address the complexities of marital status when the husband is not physically present, distinguishing it from immediate divorce protocols.
